# rgctl

> Open-source code knowledge graph for LLM agents. Index once (`discover`), then query compact JSON — callers, blast radius, CFG/PDG slices, communities, semantic search, OSV reachability, lossless CST write-back, and migration planning.

Website: https://rgctl.io/
Repository: https://github.com/rgctl/rgctl
Website source: https://github.com/rgctl/rgctl-website
Install: `curl -fsSL https://rgctl.io/install.sh | sh`

## Capabilities

- Typed code knowledge graph across 69 language plugins: 24 Tier-1 custom AST plugins (Bash, C, C++, C#, Dart, Elixir, ERB, Go, Groovy, HCL, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, Lua, Markdown, PHP, Puppet, Python, Ruby, Rust, Scala, SQL, Swift, TypeScript) and 45 Tier-2 & Mainframe plugins (Ada, Apex, Clojure, CMake, COBOL, CSS, CUDA, D, Emacs Lisp, Elm, Erlang, Fortran, F#, GDScript, Gleam, GLSL, GraphQL, Haskell, HTML, JCL, JSON, Julia, Makefile, MATLAB, Nix, Objective-C, OCaml, Odin, Pascal/Delphi, Perl, PL/I, PowerShell, Prisma, Protocol Buffers, R, Racket, Scheme, Solidity, Starlark, Svelte, TOML, Verilog/SystemVerilog, VHDL, YAML, Zig)
- Structured queries: `find`, `callers`, `callees`, `relations`, `inventory`, `diff`
- Blast radius; Fast-Leiden communities; PageRank / sampled betweenness ($K=512$) / HyperBall harmonic metrics; git churn (`discover --with-git`, `metrics --churn`)
- Hybrid CPG / CFG / PDG: `rgctl slice` builds single-function CFG/PDG lazily on demand; `discover --with-cfg` pre-builds the full repo archive (`.rgctl/analysis/cfg_pdg.archive.bin`)
- Cross-language MRO (`relations -e overrides`), SCIP overlay (`discover --scip`), frameworks / DI routes
- Lossless Red-Green CST streams (`discover --lossless` → `source.rgcs.bin` + `trivia.rgct.bin`) and byte-exact `rgctl writeback` (`verify`, `export`, `patch`)
- Semantic search over functions and docs
- OSV / vuln reachability and OpenVEX (`rgctl vuln`, `rgctl deps`)
- Agent pack via `rgctl install --skill` (core `rgctl` + `/rgctl:review` · `/rgctl:vuln` · `/rgctl:migrate`)

## CLI (JSON-first)

- `rgctl discover .` — index repo → `.rgctl/` (optional `--with-git`, `--scip <PATH.scip>`, `--with-cfg`, `--with-universe`, `--lossless`)
- `rgctl update` / `rgctl watch` / `rgctl merge` — incremental refresh, file watch, multi-repo park-and-resolve
- `rgctl -f json find|callers|callees|relations|inventory|blast-radius|cpg|slice|metrics|status|diff`
- `rgctl relations <SYM> -e overrides` / `rgctl relations <FILE> -e cochangeswith`
- `rgctl metrics --pagerank` / `--churn` / `--communities`
- `rgctl slice <FILE> --line <N> --variable <VAR>` — lazy CFG/PDG (optional `--with-alias`, `--taint`)
- `rgctl clones --mode exact|bloom|fragment` — Type 1–4 (SESE + 1-WL fragment)
- `rgctl writeback verify|export|patch` — lossless source verification, reconstruction, and span-safe refactoring
- `rgctl semantic index` / `rgctl semantic query`
- `rgctl review paths` / `rgctl review check` (PR gates; `pr-check` is a compatibility alias)
- `rgctl check --policy policy.toml` — declarative architectural policy enforcement
- `rgctl completions <bash|zsh|fish|elvish|powershell>` — shell completion script generation
